passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: (dollars in millions, except share and per-share amounts) The following Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations (“MD&A”) is intended to help the reader understand our results of operations and financial condition. MD&A is provided as a supplement to, and should be read in conjunction with, our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto included in Part II, Item 8 (Financial Statements and Supplementary Data) of this Form 10-K. Overview Our Business Howmet is a global leader in lightweight metals engineering and manufacturing. Howmet’s innovative, multi-material products, which may include nickel, titanium, aluminum, and cobalt, are used worldwide in the aerospace (commercial and defense), commercial transportation, gas turbines, and other markets. Howmet is a global company operating in 19 countries. Based upon the country where the point of shipment occurred, North America and Europe generated 72% and 22%, respectively, of Howmet’s sales in 2025. In addition to the United States, Canada, and Mexico in North America and France, United Kingdom, Hungary, and Germany in Europe, Howmet has operating activities in numerous other countries and regions, including Japan and China. Governmental policies, laws and regulations, and other economic factors, including inflation, customer requirements, tariffs, and fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates and interest rates, affect the results of operations in countries with such activities. Recent Developments On December 22, 2025, Howmet Aerospace entered into a transaction with Stanley Black & Decker, pursuant to which the Company has agreed to purchase CAM, for a cash purchase price of approximately $1.8 billion, subject to customary adjustments. The Proposed CAM Acquisition is expected to close in the first half of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. On February 6, 2026, the Company acquired Brunner Manufacturing Co. Inc., a small privately-held manufacturer of high-quality fastener products in the U.S., for an all-cash purchase price. See “Business” in Part I, Item 1 and “Liquidity and Capital Resources” in Part II, Item 7 for more information. Management Review of 2025 and Outlook The Company derived approximately 70% of its revenue from products sold to the commercial and defense aerospace markets for the year ended December 31, 2025. The timing and level of future aircraft builds by original equipment manufacturers are subject to changes and uncertainties, which may cause our future results to differ from prior periods due to changes in product mix in certain segments. In 2025, Sales increased 11% from 2024 primarily as a result of growth in the commercial aerospace, defense aerospace, and gas turbines markets, including engine spares, favorable product pricing, and cost pass through, partially offset by lower volumes in the commercial transportation market. Product price increases are in excess of material and inflationary cost pass through to our customers. Income before income taxes increased 33% from 2024. credit_strengths.text: Howmet's revenue and operating income have expanded steadily across the annual trend, with operating margin above the sector median and a rising operating cash flow base. This scale and profitability support internal funding of growth and shareholder returns without straining the balance sheet.

Gross leverage and net leverage both sit below the sector median, while interest coverage exceeds the sector median. The indicative financial risk profile is Minimal, with substantial headroom before the next leverage threshold, giving the issuer capacity to absorb the pending acquisition.

key_risks.text: The pending CAM acquisition for approximately one point eight billion dollars, expected to close in the first half of the next fiscal year, represents a material cash outflow that could lift leverage toward the next threshold if funded with debt rather than free cash flow.

Howmet derives roughly seventy percent of revenue from commercial and defense aerospace, where aircraft build rates are subject to change and uncertainty. A slowdown in original equipment manufacturer demand would pressure volumes, margins, and cash generation, potentially weakening debt-service metrics.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure, leaving free cash flow that represents a substantial share of debt. Interest coverage is strong and above the sector median, indicating ample capacity to service obligations from recurring operations.

The debt maturity profile is well laddered, with only a modest portion due in the next twelve months and no concentration in any single later year. Cash on hand and free cash flow provide ample liquidity to meet near-term maturities without refinancing pressure.

overall_credit_view.text: Howmet's credit profile is supported by leading aerospace exposure, expanding margins, and leverage below sector medians. The Minimal indicative risk profile and substantial threshold headroom suggest resilience, though the pending acquisition and aerospace cyclicality warrant monitoring.

Shareholder distributions absorb a meaningful share of free cash flow, and the pending acquisition will compete for the same cash. We view the credit as well positioned, but expect leverage to remain a key watch item if debt-funded M&A proceeds.

credit_strengths.text: Howmet 的收入及經營利潤在年度趨勢中穩步擴張，經營利潤率高于行業中位數，且經營現金流基礎持續上升。此規模及盈利能力支持以內部資金滿足增長及股東回報，而不會對資產負債表造成壓力。
總槓桿及淨槓桿均低於行業中位數，而利息覆蓋率則高於行業中位數。指示性財務風險狀況為極低，距離下一槓桿門檻仍有充裕空間，使發行人具備吸收待完成收購的能力。

key_risks.text: 待完成的 CAM 收購金額約為十八億美元，預計於下一財政年度上半年完成，代表一項重大現金流出，若以債務而非自由現金流撥付，可能將槓桿推升至下一門檻。
Howmet 約七成收入來自商用及國防航空航天領域，該領域的飛機建造率可能出現變動及不確定性。原始設備製造商需求放緩將對銷量、利潤率及現金產生構成壓力，並可能削弱償債指標。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流穩健覆蓋資本開支，留下的自由現金流佔債務相當大的比例。利息覆蓋率強勁且高於行業中位數，顯示從經常性營運中償付義務的能力充裕。
債務到期結構分佈良好，未來十二個月內到期的部分僅屬溫和，且並無集中於任何單一較後年份。手頭現金及自由現金流提供充裕流動性以應付短期到期債務，而無再融資壓力。

overall_credit_view.text: Howmet 的信用狀況受到領先的航空航天業務敞口、利潤率擴張及低於行業中位數的槓桿所支持。極低的指示性風險狀況及充裕的門檻空間顯示具韌性，惟待完成收購及航空航天週期性值得監察。
股東分派佔自由現金流一個有意義的比例，而待完成收購將競爭同一筆現金。我們認為該信用狀況定位良好，但若以債務撥付的併購繼續推進，預期槓桿將仍是關鍵觀察項目。
